title: SimplyOpen manifest v0
description: Describes how to show and run one Python project. Saved as simplyopen.json in the project's top folder.

name.description: Short app name shown in the window title.

description.description: One or two plain-English sentences saying what the app does.

entry.description: The Python file to run, relative to the project folder.

requirements.description: File listing the libraries to install, relative to the project folder. Leave out if the project needs none.

action_label.description: Text on the main button. Defaults to "Run".

inputs.description: The controls to show, in order. Each one becomes one command-line argument.

id.description: Unique name for this input, used as the key in "sample".

label.description: Plain-English text shown next to the control.

type.description: file: pick a file. text: type anything. number: type a number. choice: pick one of "options".

flag.description: How the value is passed to the script: "--width" gives `--width 800`; null passes the bare value as a positional argument, in the order inputs are listed.

required.description: If true, the user must fill this in before running.

extensions.description: For file inputs: allowed file endings, without the dot.

options.description: For choice inputs: the choices. "value" goes to the script, "label" is shown to the user.

results.description: Where output goes. The Runner creates a new folder for every run and passes its path to the script with this flag.

sample.description: Known-good values for an automatic test run, keyed by input id. File values are paths relative to the project folder.
